'''Alien Control''' was an organization within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] dealing with the genocidal task of population control within various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Korvus]] was a member of the organization.
